procedure: State: Competing local earlier-state accounts predict different responsive locations within the same permitted assay region. Procedure: Predict locations from each account, apply the selective assay with blanks/positives and interference checks, compare the resulting response pattern with those predictions, and choose the single permitted adjacent-patch or witness follow-up that distinguishes surviving accounts without destroying needed material. Limits and stopping conditions: False positives, sensitivity, damage, missing witnesses and nonunique histories remain explicit.

inferential_warrant: Presumptive detection constrains material presence; only independent overlay and witness evidence connect that finding to a bounded revision account. Neither detection nor nonresponse proves an entire history.
problem_decomposition: Separate detection, local-state alternatives and independent chronological reconstruction.
next_inquiry: Choose the discriminating nondestructive follow-up, stop at the assay/follow-up budget and report surviving states without invented dates.
